questions.q: When can you keep the props on the drone on the bench?
options: When the battery isn't plugged in
When the ARM switch is off
questions.explain: The only reliable rule: no props on the bench. Any exception will end in an injury one day.

questions.q: What does the RXLOSS arming disable flag mean?
questions.explain: Without a valid receiver signal Betaflight won't let you arm.

questions.q: The drone won't arm, the OSD shows ARMSWITCH. The cause?
questions.explain: Protection against arming right after power-on: turn the switch off and on again.

questions.q: What do you do if an arming disable flag keeps you from taking off?
questions.explain: The flags are a safety net. Disabling the check removes the symptom, not the danger.
Two-stage arming lowers the chance of accidental activation — especially with heavy props.

questions.q: What do you do with a battery that heats up with no load after a crash?
options: Discharge it to zero with a flashlight
questions.explain: Heating with no load is a sign of an internal short. Such a battery is taken out of service.

questions.q: The DSHOT_TELEM flag in status means:
options: No eRPM with the RPM filter on
Throttle not at zero when arming
questions.explain: Check dshot_bidir, the ESC firmware, the wires.

questions.q: How do you put out a burning LiPo?
options: Water from a bottle, a little at a time
questions.explain: It burns with its own oxidizer; what matters is isolation and cooling.
